newsitem.title: USA: Regeneron, Pharmacopeia in drug pact.
newsitem.headline: Regeneron, Pharmacopeia in drug pact.

text.p: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc and Pharmacopeia Inc said Thursday they have agreed to collaborate on developing a class of "small molecule" drugs that could be taken orally.
The companies said they would jointly own any potential drugs that are developed.
"The collaboration integrates Regeneron's strengths in the field of molecular and cell biology with our strengths in chemistry and screening," said Pharmacopeia Chief Executive Joseph Mollica.
"Small molecule" drugs would affect natural proteins that promote and protect certain cells that become vulnerable in a variety of diseases.
Current protein-based drugs affecting these cells are being clinically evaluated for their affects on conditions ranging from obesity to HIV infection, the companies said.
